scope: Reuse one existing feature layout after loss or opening, then allow an uncertain proposal to earn a verified local detail refinement. No source, crop or acceptance-threshold changes.

regular.timing: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

stop.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

intervention.method: HTTP source override: block the actual compute worker for 30 s before fitting (empty), or immediately after a real validated checkpoint with error <= 0.6% (keep), or finer paper resolution 700 and original-image error <= 3% (keep-finer), or the new detail-polishing stage with resolution 700 and original-image error <= 2.6% (keep-detail). Cancel-finishing additionally yields for 2 s in finalization. No geometry, counts or seed is supplied.

limitations: The horizontal crop shift still fails at ten seconds.
Passing mask, feature, geometry and paper checks does not remove all visible seams or frame defects.
No ground-truth cutting paths enter fitting, and photo agreement is not exact ground-truth template agreement.
No physical cutting or assembly test.
